name: read-only-preview-api
goal: API cấp đúng đề đã tạo và runtime cho host mà không tạo attempt.
design_constraints: Keep the existing HOST_ADMIN-owned GET /api/v1/sessions/{id}/exam-preview envelope and add only backward-compatible fields.
Resolve runtime and timing through an assessment-owned public facade/resolver so session preview never imports attempt.internal.
Preserve student timing parity, stable snapshot item identity, option order/blank indexes, signed media expiry, and answer stripping.
No preview endpoint may generate snapshots, create attempts, mutate session state, consume quota, or write outbox/notification records.
Use V9__allow_session_preview_ready_notification.sql only if Phase 4 requires a migration; do not edit dirty V7/V8 files.

repository_conventions: Spring controllers use CurrentUserContext, HOST_ADMIN authorization, service-owned transactions, and ApiResponse.
Assessment owns reusable snapshot/runtime/timing contracts; session owns tenant-owned preview orchestration.
API tests use existing MockMvc/service/contract test conventions and must assert no answer keys are serialized.
boundaries: Only the exact API, API-client type, and Phase 2 test/report paths in quang-execution-file-manifest.md may change.
Do not change Flutter preview behavior, web notification UI, Flyway V7/V8, or unrelated dirty worktree files in this phase.
applicable_rules: Read the complete API standards and relevant module instructions before source edits.
Keep cross-module dependencies directional and public; do not expose internal attempt DTOs or answer data.
Preserve common error response codes and tenant isolation.
allowed_exceptions: Quality gate is skipped by Quang and must remain skipped_by_user; unit tests are required and owned by ck:test.

steps.description: Trích read-only content/timing resolver vào public assessment facade/DTO phù hợp module boundaries; student loader và session preview dùng chung. Không import attempt.internal. Timing parity theo handoff §4.
success_criteria: Regression test resolver cho cùng snapshot sinh runtime/timing bằng student hiện có; không có session import attempt.internal.

steps.description: Mở rộng ExamPreviewResponse additive: snapshotItemPublicId, runtime/mapping metadata, resolved timing và media expiry; giữ fields cũ, options blankIndex/order; strip answers bằng DTO riêng.
success_criteria: Serialized contract tests chứa stable item id và timing; giữ options/blankIndex; không có answer keys.

steps.description: Giữ GET list/detail/exam-preview hiện có HOST_ADMIN, tenant-owned; existing snapshot đủ để xem, không gate OPEN/enrollment/quota. Common error cho chưa có snapshot, nguồn timing/media thiếu; không auto generate.
success_criteria: Parameterized API tests H1/tenant B/student và các status trả đúng common response; write spies=0.

steps.description: Cập nhật API-client exam preview types cùng contract mới, giữ web consumer tương thích. Adapter audio phải dùng signed URL chứ không dùng UUID media như URL.
success_criteria: API-client typecheck và existing exam-preview consumer typecheck exit 0 với DTO mới.

steps.description: Bổ sung contract/ownership/read-only tests và resolver timing parity tests vào existing test classes hoặc file mới ghi manifest; AP01–10/AU05–06. Assert absence answer keys và các calls write=0.
success_criteria: AP01–10/AU05–06 contract/tenant/read-only tests pass, prohibited service invocations=0.

steps.description: Run API compile, focused tests + regression loader/timer tests, client typecheck; ghi DTO mẫu đã strip và exit codes trước phase app.
success_criteria: Logs compile/focused regression/typecheck có exit 0; lỗi baseline/skip được tách rõ.
